cards.text: In the third year of Hoshea son of Elah, king of Israel, Judah gets a new king: Hezekiah son of Ahaz. His mother is Abi, the daughter of Zechariah, and he's twenty-five years old. Twenty-five, running a WHOLE kingdom, and friend, some mornings I can't run one oven timer.

cards.question: Every king needs a home base. Where does Hezekiah, the new king of Judah, reign?

cards.text: He'll reign there twenty-nine years. TWENTY-NINE! Friend, I've owned aprons that didn't last twenty-nine weeks.

cards.question: True or false: King Hezekiah does what was right in the eyes of the LORD.

cards.text: Just like his father David had done. And Hezekiah gets right to work: he removes the high places, shatters the sacred pillars, and then turns to the Asherah poles.

cards.question: King Hezekiah has removed the high places and shattered the sacred pillars. What does he do to the Asherah poles?

cards.text: Then there's a bronze snake called Nehushtan, the one Moses made back in the wilderness (Numbers 21:9). I know a thing or two about being old and kept around, friend, but this snake makes the expired coupon I shared a drawer with look BRAND new.

cards.question: True or false: King Hezekiah keeps Nehushtan, the bronze snake Moses made, safe in the temple.
Hezekiah demolishes the bronze snake Moses made. Why?

answers.text: People had been burning incense to it
It had cracked beyond any repair
The king of Assyria wanted it

cards.text: Here's the heart of it: "Hezekiah trusted in the LORD, the God of Israel." Then the writer lines him up next to the other kings of Judah, and friend, it's bake-off judging time: somebody's getting a ribbon, and somebody's getting a polite little nod.

cards.question: True or false: No king of Judah was like Hezekiah, either before him or after him.
Hezekiah stays faithful and doesn't turn from following the LORD. He keeps the commandments the LORD had given ___.

cards.text: "And the LORD was with Hezekiah, and he prospered wherever he went." Then he makes a BOLD move about the king of Assyria, and I mean BOLD, friend, like walking up to the biggest guy in the room and reaching for the last cookie on his plate.

cards.question: Hezekiah rebels against the king of Assyria and refuses to ___ him.
Hezekiah is on a ROLL. Which people does he defeat as far as Gaza, from watchtower to fortified city?

cards.text: Meanwhile, in Hezekiah's fourth year, which is Hoshea's seventh, Shalmaneser king of Assyria marches against Samaria in Israel and besieges it. Nobody in, nobody out, and I know that feeling, friend, because that junk drawer was a siege with takeout menus.

cards.question: The Assyrians besiege Samaria. At the end of three ___, they capture it.
True or false: After Samaria falls, the king of Assyria exiles the Israelites to Egypt.
The Assyrians capture Samaria and exile the Israelites to Assyria. Why does this happen to the Israelites?

answers.text: They would not listen to the LORD or obey
Their city walls were built too low
Their army was too small to fight back

cards.text: Trust me, friend, Hezekiah's story is NOT done, so keep that oven warm. I'd say more, but my timer's going off, and the last time I ignored it I baked a tray of charcoal.
